posts.title: BPE: How Models See Text
posts.description: When you type a sentence into an LLM, the model never sees your letters. It sees a sequence of integers. Before any attention head fires or any logit is computed, a tokenizer chops your text into pieces called tokens and looks up each one’s ID in a fixed vocabulary.
